why: HELIOD TO BRACKET 3, the pilot's call 2026-11-12: v1.4.0 reads B4 only for 8 Game Changers. Keep Rhystic Study, Smothering Tithe and Mystical Tutor. 'Approach of the Second Sun is critical line in this deck': four direct finders (Mystical Tutor, Personal Tutor, Solve the Equation, Long-Term Plans), Sensei's Divining Top to redraw the 7th-from-top copy, and Teferi, Time Raveler or Silence so no spell can answer the second cast (stack 007, checker-passed). 'Flashing spells for discount on opponents' turns, built for a 4-5 player pod': Cut a Deal, Lore Broker and Mind's Eye feed and pay off the table's draws; Fellwar Stone and Prismatic Lens get Heliod down sooner; Spellskite redirects removal off Heliod (games 001 and 003); Winds of Abandon is a one-sided wipe that keeps him.

commits.message: b3-v1: Heliod to bracket 3 — keep Rhystic Study, Smothering Tithe, Mystical Tutor (Approach line); Sphinx -> Teferi Time Raveler, Enlightened Tutor -> Solve the Equation, Teferi's Protection -> Flawless Maneuver, Fierce Guardianship -> Mana Drain, Cyclonic Rift -> Venser, Shaper Savant (strategist, 2026-11-12)
b3-v1: Day of Judgment -> Winds of Abandon (pilot owns it; one-sided, exile, keeps Heliod alive; instant-speed via Heliod's flash)
b3-v1: the Approach line made faster — Personal Tutor (for Disenchant), Silence (for Cathar Commando), Sensei's Divining Top (for Mana Drain); 3 Game Changers, 0 two-card infinites

b3-v1: faster Heliod (Fellwar Stone, Prismatic Lens for Horn of Greed, Skyscribing) and the draw-discount engine (Mind's Eye, Spellskite, Cut a Deal, Lore Broker for Psychosis Crawler, Archangel of Tithes, Secure the Wastes, Kefnet the Mindful)
